Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
explanation: Correct option: (C). The chapter agrees that the Commission has become more independent and assertive, so A is true. But this is not because its powers or constitutional protection increased; it has started using the powers it always had more effectively. So R is false.

stem: One reform proposal is to bar any candidate with a criminal case from contesting, even if an appeal is pending. Which is the strongest objection to this proposal?
options: It would reduce the number of women who contest elections
The person may later be acquitted on appeal
It would take away the voting rights of ordinary citizens
It would change the FPTP system into a PR system
explanation: Correct option: (B). Barring a candidate while an appeal is pending may punish someone who is later acquitted, which conflicts with fairness to the accused; this is why the chapter notes there is no consensus on such suggestions. The proposal has no link to women candidates, does not affect who can vote, and does not change the method of counting votes.
